instruction: Ensure every piece of text on this slide, table included, is in bold.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires selecting all text content (including table) and applying bold formatting. The custom getter extracts bold status of all text runs in the presentation, and the metric verifies that all runs are bold. Verified that the original presentation has text in both regular shapes and table cells that need formatting.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts bold status from all text runs including both regular shapes and table cells
Metric correctly compares result with expected using proper parameter handling (expected.get('all_bold') without incorrect 'rules' access)
Expected value semantically correct: all_bold=true matches instruction requirement
Postconfig properly saves file (Ctrl+S) to ensure state persistence before verification
Edge case handling: getter checks total_runs > 0 to prevent errors on empty presentations
Complete coverage: instruction requires all text (including table) to be bold, and getter verifies exactly that
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor ambiguity: instruction says 'this slide' (singular) but getter checks all slides in presentation. Acceptable if presentation has single slide, but could be more precise if multi-slide presentations are expected
